description: Defines a class for configuring Kafka authentication with SASL mechanisms, including validation and application of configuration properties.

classes.name: KafkaAuthenticationSpecificConfig
classes.description: Handles Kafka SASL authentication configuration, validation, and application based on connection details.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the connection has necessary credentials for SASL authentication.

methods.name: validateOrThrow
methods.description: Validates the connection's SASL configuration, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if the connection's SASL configuration is valid.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies SASL configuration properties to producer properties based on connection details.
